This role requires the candidate to work remotely on a part-time basis from France. Client Overview Our client is a global artificial intelligence technology company specializing in the development of advanced large language models (LLMs), speech recognition technologies, multilingual AI systems, and data annotation solutions.

The organization collaborates with leading AI research laboratories and enterprise technology companies worldwide to accelerate the development of next-generation artificial intelligence through high-quality human-generated data.

Supporting a diverse portfolio of multilingual AI initiatives, the company works with language specialists, voice professionals, and annotation experts across the globe to improve the accuracy, contextual understanding, and performance of cutting-edge AI systems used in speech processing, conversational AI, and natural language understanding.

Job Role The French Audio QA Annotation Specialist is a freelance project-based role responsible for reviewing, evaluating, and validating French audio recordings to ensure they meet the highest quality standards required for AI speech recognition and audio annotation projects.

Working as part of a multilingual quality assurance team, this role focuses on assessing recording accuracy, pronunciation, fluency, audio clarity, annotation consistency, and compliance with project guidelines.

The successful candidate will help ensure that all approved audio data contributes effectively to the development of advanced multilingual AI speech technologies. This opportunity is offered as a flexible freelance engagement rather than a traditional full-time or part-time employment position.

Key Responsibilities Review and evaluate French audio recordings for quality, pronunciation accuracy, clarity, and natural speech delivery. Verify annotation accuracy and ensure all submitted recordings comply with project guidelines and quality standards.

Identify audio quality issues including background noise, recording inconsistencies, pronunciation errors, or technical defects. Provide structured quality feedback and recommend improvements when recordings do not meet required standards. Ensure consistency across annotated datasets by following established QA processes and evaluation criteria.

Collaborate with project reviewers and annotation teams to maintain high-quality multilingual datasets. Maintain accurate documentation of review outcomes and quality assurance findings. Support the continuous improvement of AI speech recognition models through high-quality audio validation.

Candidate Requirements Native-level fluency in French with excellent listening comprehension and pronunciation knowledge. Minimum 1 year of experience in audio quality assurance, audio annotation, localization, transcription review, voice-over, dubbing, ADR, or related language quality roles.

Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify pronunciation, fluency, and audio quality issues accurately. Excellent understanding of French linguistic nuances, accents, grammar, and natural speech patterns. Experience reviewing audio recordings and applying quality standards consistently.

Familiarity with audio editing or audio playback software is preferred. Strong analytical skills with the ability to provide clear and actionable quality feedback. Ability to work independently while meeting project deadlines and quality targets. Job Code: #785 Originally posted on Himalayas

This role requires the candidate to work remotely on a part-time basis in eligible Arabic-speaking countries. Client Overview Our client is a global artificial intelligence technology company focused on accelerating the development and deployment of next-generation AI systems.

The organization collaborates with leading AI research laboratories and enterprise customers worldwide to develop advanced language models, speech recognition technologies, multimodal AI solutions, and large-scale machine learning applications.

As part of its growing AI data operations, the company partners with highly skilled language professionals, voice talents, and domain experts across multiple countries to support the development of multilingual speech recognition and audio understanding systems through high-quality audio annotation and voice data collection projects.

Job Role The Audio Annotation Trainer – Arabic is a freelance, project-based role responsible for producing high-quality Arabic voice recordings and supporting AI audio annotation initiatives that help train advanced speech recognition and language models.

This role is ideal for individuals with previous voice acting, dubbing, ADR, or localization experience who possess excellent vocal control, emotional expression, and native-level Arabic pronunciation.

Successful contributors will record professional-quality voice samples, interpret scripts naturally, revise recordings based on feedback, and deliver high-quality audio assets that contribute to the development of next-generation multilingual AI systems.

This opportunity is offered as a flexible remote freelance engagement rather than a traditional full-time or part-time employment position. Key Responsibilities Record professional-quality voice-over content from a home recording studio or approved recording environment.

Deliver scripts with natural Arabic pronunciation, emotional range, appropriate pacing, and consistent vocal quality. Interpret scripts while adapting delivery style based on project requirements and creative direction. Revise recordings based on reviewer feedback to ensure quality and annotation accuracy.

Submit audio files according to required technical specifications and project formats. Maintain high recording quality standards while meeting project timelines and delivery deadlines. Collaborate with project reviewers throughout the evaluation and quality assurance process.

Contribute to the development of multilingual AI speech recognition and audio understanding systems. Candidate Requirements Native-level fluency in Arabic with excellent pronunciation and verbal communication skills. Minimum 1 year of experience in voice acting, dubbing, ADR, localization, or other voice-related work.

Strong vocal control, versatility, and emotional delivery across different speaking styles. Access to professional or high-quality home recording equipment suitable for remote voice recording. Ability to follow creative direction and efficiently implement revisions.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality recordings within project deadlines. Experience using basic audio editing software is preferred. A demo reel showcasing different voice styles is highly preferred. Background in acting, performing arts, or other creative disciplines is considered a strong advantage.

The future of AI — whether in training or evaluation, classical ML or agentic workflows — starts with high-quality data.
At HumanSignal , we’re building the platform that powers the creation, curation, and evaluation of that data. From fine-tuning foundation models to validating agent behaviors in production, our tools are used by leading AI teams to ensure models are grounded in real-world signal, not noise.
Our open-source product, Label Studio , has become the de facto standard for labeling and evaluating data across modalities — from text and images to time series and agents-in-environments. With over 250,000 users and hundreds of millions of labeled samples, it’s the most widely adopted OSS solution for teams working on building AI systems.
Label Studio Enterprise builds on that traction with the security, collaboration, and scalability features needed to support mission-critical AI pipelines — powering everything from model training datasets to eval test sets to continuous feedback loops.We started before foundation models were mainstream, and we’re doubling down now that AI is eating the world. If you're excited to help leading AI teams build smarter, more accurate systems — we’d love to talk.

Get Paid to Review Car Damage Photos — Flexible, Remote, Freelance Work Looking for a flexible way to earn extra money on the side? We're hiring freelance contractors to work on a photo review project for a leading European insurance company — and you can do it from anywhere in the EU, on your own schedule.

What you'll be doing: Reviewing photos of damaged vehicles and marking the affected areas — things like scratches, dents, cracks, and missing parts — and identifying which part of the car is involved (door, bumper, hood, fender, etc.). Your work directly helps insurance customers receive faster, fairer damage assessments.

Full training is provided through clear written guidelines with visual examples. This is a great fit if you have a background in:

Auto insurance claims or appraisal
Auto body or mechanic work
Car dealership or parts experience
Any field where identifying vehicle damage and parts is second nature

Must be based in the EU
100% remote, work at your own pace
Pays roughly €11/hour
Project volume is expected to be substantial, with strong potential for increased workload and extended project duration as things scale
Freelance/contract work — perfect for picking up extra cash on the side

Are you a Swedish language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery.

With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for Swedish speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for Swedish language specialists who live and breathe phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics, sociolinguistics, and language acquisition in Swedish.

You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, noun-adjective agreement, sentence structure, regional dialects, word order, idiomatic expressions, and cultural context—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A master’s or PhD in Swedish language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, teaching experience, or hands‑on linguistic analysis projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential. Ready to turn your Swedish language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI?

Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world. We offer a pay range of $8-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above.

As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Are you an experienced PC gamer eager to help shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are expanding beyond text into interactive, AI-generated environments capable of simulating dynamic virtual worlds.

With high-quality human feedback, these systems can improve spatial reasoning, objective tracking, responsiveness, and environmental consistency. That training data begins with you—we need your gaming experience to help refine the next generation of AI-driven world models.

We’re looking for raters based in the US West region with strong PC gaming experience, particularly familiarity with keyboard and mouse controls and standard WASD movement.

This project involves interacting directly with an AI-generated world model to navigate environments, complete defined objectives, and evaluate how effectively the system responds to player inputs and in-game scenarios.

On a typical session, you will navigate through virtual environments, complete structured tasks or objectives, assess world coherence and responsiveness, identify navigation or physics inconsistencies, and document reproducible issues in model behavior.

You will provide clear, structured feedback on performance gaps, unexpected behaviors, objective clarity, environmental realism, and interaction smoothness. Attention to detail and the ability to articulate gameplay observations precisely are essential. Strong PC gaming experience is required.

Familiarity with first-person or third-person navigation using WASD controls is essential. Prior experience in Gaming QA, bug reporting, structured playtesting, or usability testing is a significant plus. Entry-level candidates with strong gaming proficiency and the ability to document observations clearly are encouraged to apply.

Ready to turn your gaming experience into valuable training data for advanced AI systems? Apply today and help improve interactive AI environments through hands-on evaluation. Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

You'll be joining our Okta Customer Acceleration organization, a high-impact team focused on defining and optimizing the self-service journey for our customers across Knowledge, Online Support, and Communities. Our mission is to transform the customer experience by enabling efficient, accurate, and engaging self-service solutions.
The Opportunity
We're looking for an experienced AI Trainer and Optimization Analyst to take full ownership of our customer support agentic experiences. This is a critical specialist role that offers the chance to directly influence millions of customer interactions annually.
You will act as the primary expert on the AI agent's performance, applying a strategic mindset to continuously analyze conversational data and leverage analytics to enhance the bot's ability. You will be responsible for:
Implementing prompt engineering best practices.
Ensuring the agent provides accurate, efficient, and on-brand support.
Managing the bot's tone and ethical guardrails to prevent hallucination and incorrect assumptions.
"Thinking bigger" to bring new, strategic ideas for leveraging the agentic experience for maximum customer impact.
What you’ll be doing
You will be the dedicated owner of the AI agent's conversational experience:
Own Conversational Quality & Tone: Act as the primary owner for the AI agent's output, managing the content, tone, and ethical guardrails to ensure responses are accurate, on-brand, and avoid inappropriate or incorrect assumptions and "hallucination."
Prompt Engineering & Training: Develop, test, and deploy advanced prompt engineering techniques, training materials, and conversational flows to enhance the AI agent's accuracy, intent recognition, and overall effectiveness.
Performance Analysis & Optimization: Proactively monitor and analyze AI agent performance metrics, including deflection rates, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores, translating data into actionable training and optimization plans.
Gap Identification & Remediation: Review and categorize high-volume AI conversations to identify new customer intents, common misclassifications, and critical content gaps in the knowledge base that require remediation.
Strategic Collaboration: Work closely with the Content, Knowledge, and Customer Experience teams to understand common customer issues and translate those insights into strategic AI training plans, focusing on high-ticket volume areas.
Continuous Improvement: Maintain and update conversation scripts to reflect product and policy changes, and continuously identify and report on agent bugs, system gaps, and areas for potential escalation.
